brief.topic: Build a 20-case eval set in a spreadsheet
brief.audience: PMs who want a hands-on first eval set

coreInsight: A useful first eval set is 20 real questions in a spreadsheet with expected behaviour and a pass rule, re-scored after every change.

hooks.text: An eval set in a spreadsheet.
You don’t need an eval platform to start.
20 rows that tell you if your AI works.

selectionRationale: Highest total (23/25): concrete and doable, and the reel shows the columns, sample rows and a scored run.

caption.opening: Your first eval set doesn’t need a platform. It needs 20 real questions and an afternoon.
body:
Columns:
→ INPUT: a real question from users or support tickets
→ EXPECTED: what a good response does (answer, decline, ask, hand off)
→ PASS IF: one rule you apply the same way every time
Mix about 10 common questions, 5 edge cases and 5 it should refuse. Score it now, and again after every prompt or model change.
(The 14/20 run in the reel is illustrative.)
